title: Aandhiyan ban ke aayein
chords:
[Verse 1]
Aandhiyan ban ke aayein,
Zindagi ke fikr, (2)
Kaun hai tera rachnewala,
Hai bharosa tera kidher |

[CHORUS]
Gin Gin ke stuti karoon,
Beshumar tere daanon ke liye,
Ab tak tune sambhala mujhe,
Apni baahon mein liye hue |
..repeat

[Verse 2]
Tere shatru ka nishana,
Tujh par hoga na safal, (2)
Aankhon ki putli jaise,
Vo rakhega, tujhe har pal |
..repeat

[Verse 3]
Aaye tujhe jo mitane,
Ve shastra honge beasar, (2)
Tera rachnewala tujhpar,
Rakhta hai apni nazar |
..repeat

[Outro]
https://youtu.be/yWvBdLdvTFc
